news.headline: NeurAxis Announces Medical Coverage Policy Milestone, Expanding Access to Over 18 million additional Covered Lives
news.summary: NeurAxis secured new medical policy coverage from a major national health insurer for its PENFS therapy, adding roughly 18 million covered lives across multiple states and lifting the company's total U.S. coverage footprint for PENFS to over 120 million lives. CEO Brian Carrico said the win demonstrates tangible progress on the company's plan to expand payer coverage and scale IB-Stim commercialization.

news.headline: NeurAxis to Participate in the Lytham Partners Fall 2026 Investor Conference
news.summary: NeurAxis said management will give a webcast presentation and hold one-on-one investor meetings at the virtual Lytham Partners Fall 2026 Investor Conference on September 29-30, 2026. The company's presentation is scheduled for 11:45 a.m. ET on Tuesday, September 29, with a replay to be made available afterward.

news.headline: NeurAxis at iAccess Alpha conference: payer wins drive growth
news.summary: Presenting at the iAccess Alpha Virtual Best Ideas Fall Investment Conference, CEO Brian Carrico told investors that continued payer wins and an expanding commercial team could drive a strong run for NeurAxis over the next 15 to 18 months. Management framed the Category I CPT code and new medical-policy coverage as the key drivers converting IB-Stim into a broadly reimbursed therapy.

news.headline: NeurAxis directors granted RSUs following stock option exchange
news.summary: Following stockholder approval of a stock option exchange (effective July 24, 2026) that swapped 1,319,394 outstanding options for restricted stock units, NeurAxis directors including Bradley Watkins, Jane Keyser and Kristin Ferge were granted additional RSUs on August 13, 2026, vesting in three equal annual installments. The grants realign board compensation with the equity award structure adopted earlier in the year.

news.headline: NeurAxis Reports Record Second Quarter 2026 Financial Results Driven by 116% Year Over Year Revenue Growth
news.summary: NeurAxis reported Q2 2026 revenue of $1.93 million, up 116% year-over-year, with gross margin improving to 85.9% from 83.6% as new payer coverage and the CPT Category I code lifted average selling prices. Shares fell after the report despite the growth because the company's per-share loss of $0.19 came in wider than the $0.16 loss analysts had forecast.

catalysts.label: Lytham Partners Fall 2026 Investor Conference
catalysts.detail: Virtual conference with a NeurAxis management webcast presentation at 11:45 a.m. ET on Sept 29 and one-on-one investor meetings; scheduled and publicly confirmed, now days away.

catalysts.label: Q3 2026 earnings and business update call
catalysts.detail: Based on the company's 2026 cadence (Q1 call May 12, Q2 call Aug 11) and last year's Q3 call on Nov 11, 2025, a Q3 2026 results call would fall in early-to-mid November, but NeurAxis has not yet announced the specific date.

catalysts.label: Additional payer medical-policy coverage decisions
catalysts.detail: Management has guided toward further national and regional payer coverage wins for PENFS/IB-Stim beyond the ~120 million covered lives reached in mid-September, which would keep expanding the addressable, reimbursed patient base.

catalysts.label: State-level Medicaid fee-schedule adoption of CPT 64567
catalysts.detail: Roughly 20-25 states have still not loaded the new Category I CPT code (64567, effective Jan 1, 2026) into their Medicaid fee schedules, which continues to limit reimbursed access for Medicaid/EPSDT beneficiaries; further state adoptions would remove a near-term revenue bottleneck.

catalysts.label: Series B preferred stock coupon expiration / conversion to common
catalysts.detail: The 8.5% dividend coupon on NeurAxis's Series B preferred shares is set to expire at year-end 2026, after which conversion to common stock is expected, a contractually scheduled event that represents a known future dilution source.

pulse: NeurAxis remains on a steep growth trajectory (Q2 2026 revenue up 116% YoY to $1.93M, 85.9% gross margin) as its new Category I CPT code (64567, effective Jan 1, 2026) and rapidly expanding payer coverage -- now over 120 million covered lives after the September 16 milestone -- convert PENFS/IB-Stim into a broadly reimbursed pediatric and adult neuromodulation therapy. No new company-specific news has broken since the September 16 coverage announcement; Craig-Hallum reiterated its Buy rating and $13 price target around that release, and the next near-term catalyst is management's webcast and investor meetings at the Lytham Partners Fall 2026 conference on Sept 29-30. Investors are still watching for further payer wins, faster state Medicaid fee-schedule adoption of the new CPT code, and an as-yet-unscheduled Q3 2026 earnings call (likely early-to-mid November) to confirm the growth ramp can offset last quarter's wider-than-expected per-share loss.
